offering_ecommerce.name: Ecommerce Storefront
offering_ecommerce.tagline: Sell online with catalog, cart and integrated payments
offering_ecommerce.description: Ecommerce platform with catalog, checkout and payment gateway. Buy it as software (source code included) or use the monthly hosted subscription.

basico.name: Basic
basico.description: Storefront ready for the first 1,000 orders/month
basico.idealPara: Startups and SMBs just going online
incluye: Catalog with variants and simple stock
Email support Mon–Fri 8AM–5PM Colombia, 24h business response

profesional.name: Professional
profesional.description: For stores with 10k orders and automated tracking
profesional.idealPara: Growing brands with multiple categories shipping in Colombia

avanzado.name: Advanced
avanzado.description: Multi-channel with advanced search and anti-fraud
avanzado.idealPara: Mid-market retailers with large catalogs and complex promos
incluye: B2B and B2C in the same store
Executive reports and Data Warehouse exports
Email + WhatsApp + Slack Connect support, 2h business response

enterprise.name: Enterprise
enterprise.description: Multi-country with PCI-DSS-aligned architecture and EDI
enterprise.idealPara: Chains and holdings operating in multiple countries
incluye: Private B2B catalogs with negotiated pricing
Dedicated PIM and DAM for assets
Architecture aligned with PCI-DSS (certification at customer expense)
Jira/Zendesk tickets with audit, 1h critical / 4h high / 24h medium
Monthly executive reports for your committee

offering_ecommerce.costoNote: Gateway fees (Stripe/Wompi ~2.9% + $0.30 per tx), hosting and transactional email are paid by the customer directly to the provider.
